output.reason: [ev-e24450bf8fed] says that when `envoy.enabled` is not set, the Envoy DaemonSet is now enabled by default. That adds one Pod per Node, and Nodes already at their maximum Pod count will have one non-system-critical Pod evicted after upgrading. The note says setting `upgradeCompatibility` to 1.15 or earlier keeps the previous behavior. Cilium keeps working with the new default and the eviction only affects nodes already at capacity, so behavior-change (review) fits better than a mandatory failure kind.
